messages:
maya: heads up - promo to stable is blocked by CI. artifact uploader shows a partial upload for release-1.2.3.tar.gz (0 bytes written). deploy-bot paused promotion.
jon: ugh. can you paste the job log?
maya: log snippet: `Uploading artifacts...
[upload] /tmp/release-1.2.3.tar.gz -> registry.redwood:5000/releases/1.2.3.tar.gz
ERROR: wrote 0 bytes to /tmp/release-1.2.3.tar.gz
registry response: 500 Internal Server Error`
deploy-bot: Promotion paused for 1.2.3 due to artifact verification failure. Waiting for manual unblock or replacement artifact. :pause_button:
samir: looks like ephemeral runner disk pressure or a race in the artifact collector. saw similar when runners hit disk_evict. can we rerun with `node-label=io-heavy` and `ARTIFACT_CHUNK_SIZE=4M`?
kelly: we should not force-promote. Recommend pinning last-good image (1.2.2) for the change window and retry CI. ops-bot, can you record the hold?
ops-bot: Recorded hold: release 1.2.3 paused at 2026-03-21T15:02:01Z by CI artifact failure. Change window owner: @kelly.
jon: +1 to pin previous. also we need a short workaround: lower concurrency for the artifact uploader and clear runner tmp before job. maybe `rm -rf /tmp/artifacts/*` in pre-step.
maya: will queue a rerun with smaller concurrency and `--clean-temp`. scheduling now, ETA ~15m.
samir: if rerun still fails, fallback is to repackage artifacts into a gzipped tar with streaming upload (`tar -cz -C build . | curl -T - $REG_URL`) to avoid intermediate disk.
kelly: agree. Plan: 1) pin to 1.2.2 in release DB and note in release notes; 2) rerun CI with clean tmp + lower concurrency; 3) if rerun fails, use streaming upload as fallback; 4) do not promote until artifact checksum verified.
maya: noted, updating release notes and tagging the hold in the deploy spreadsheet.
jon: for transparency add a line to the changelog: "promotion paused due to CI artifact upload error; rerun in progress".
deploy-bot: Manual unblock is available: `deploy-bot unblock --thread 6370004321 --by <owner>` but will require checksum verification.
kelly: i'll own the manual unblock after verifying checksums. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
maya: rerun started @6370004360, will post results.
